# apipbx_caller_id_step (Resource)

Changes the caller id of a call, then continues to a destination. Set a name_prefix, a number, or both. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Put before the caller's name (up to 20 characters).
- `next_id` (String)
- `next_type` (String) Where the call goes afterwards: extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `number` (String) Replaces the caller's number (digits, optional leading +).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
